connector.name: LayerOne (DocX + Sign)
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for LayerOne DocX (documents & Factur-X) and Sign (e-signature) APIs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package layerone-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the golayerone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DOCX_API_KEY
env.description: DocX API key (documents, PDF, Factur-X). Generate at https://dev.layerone.fr

env.name: SIGN_API_KEY
env.description: Sign API key (eIDAS/PAdES e-signature). Generate at https://dev.layerone.fr
